problem: Readiness CLI validated manifest rows once, then reread mutable manifest and authority inputs to recompute its success basis.
cause: Validation API returned only errors, forcing main() to reconstruct success output from a second unvalidated filesystem snapshot.
rule: Trust-boundary validators must return the exact validated success projection and authority binding from one in-memory snapshot; CLI output must never reread or recompute from mutable inputs after validation. Validate all untrusted scalar types before hashing or set operations.
applies_to: Readiness gates, signed manifests, policy loaders, and CLI verification results
